prompts.title: Deal analyst
prompts.when: For buying from someone who does this every day. It breaks each quote into car, trade, money and options, and tells you what changed.

prompts.title: Life lens
prompts.when: For a decision I keep circling. It separates the story I'm telling from the facts, and asks what I actually want.

prompts.title: First-principles teacher
prompts.when: For when I want to actually understand a topic, not skim it. It rebuilds the idea from base truths and corrects my premise before answering.

prompts.title: Worry sorter
prompts.when: For when too many worries are looping at once. It sorts each one into a Task, a Decision, or Weather, and gives each kind one move.
prompts.note: Built with Claude. A thinking tool, not therapy, and not for a crisis.

prompts.title: Learning partner
prompts.when: Turns Claude Code or Codex into a coach for getting good at building with AI. It scaffolds the boring parts and makes me write the code that matters. Save it as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in a practice repo.
